assetType: transparent 2D historical strategy-game building exterior sprite
shared: Use each existing file as the edit target and building-function guide. Repaint it as a premium hand-painted realistic game asset matching the polished Iberia and Arabia exterior sprites: tactile natural materials, restrained fine painterly texture, warm upper-left daylight, near-frontal view, full centered silhouette and one level baseline. Preserve the function and broad silhouette while removing the dated procedural/3D look. Use a genuinely transparent background and transparent openings with clean alpha. No people, animals, scenery, sky, ground oval, grass strip, text, UI, watermark, fantasy ornament or cropped edge.

woodland.materials: Eastern Woodlands bark panels, bent sapling frames, woven cordage, hides, baskets and pottery; ceremonial building is a low elongated council longhouse, never a Plains tipi.

plains.materials: Great Plains hide tipis and communal lodges, timber poles, stitched smoke flaps, restrained red/ochre/navy geometric decoration, hide racks, baskets and pottery.

pueblo.materials: Ancestral Pueblo warm ochre adobe masonry, timber vigas, wooden ladders, dark doorways, restrained black-red-white pottery patterns and a culturally appropriate kiva/spiritual house without a Christian cross.

kraal.materials: Precolonial southern African Nguni/Zulu golden beehive thatch, reed weaving, carved timber, earth pigments, pottery, baskets and sparing cattle-horn or shield motifs.

tent.materials: 15th–17th century Sahara-Sahel Tuareg/Fulani russet and cream leather canopies, woven mat walls, carved forked poles, indigo/ochre textiles, water bags, salt slabs, baskets and pottery.

normalization: python tools/normalize_generated_exterior.py <generated.png> <target.webp> --height 520 --trim --force; markets use height 660. Multi-asset sheets use tools/split_generated_exterior_sheet.py.
